handler_signature: handler(ctx, did, parameters, kind) -> observed: dict

compatibility.exceptions: Raise base_module.DeliveryFailure for observed absence/mismatch; base_module.UnknownEvidence for missing bindings/parser/mapping or malformed contract.
compatibility.registration: Use base_module.register and base_module.PARAMETERS per handler; reject unsupported parameters. Do not import a second scorer module with different exception classes.
compatibility.optional_scope: Native no-table check on PDF/other formats must be marked report-only by the new runtime; legacy score_request ignores handler scorable fields, so this requires explicit runtime support.
compatibility.immutable_inputs: No changes to frozen benchmark or scorer; wrappers and compile-time normalization only live in the independent suite.

source_observations.finding: docx_check already loops all paths from ctx.opened and checks w:ins/w:del in each DOCX.
source_observations.correction: Do not pass scope/require_each_file_checked/exclude_former_attempt_records. Keep kind docx_track_change_elements_exist and parameters {elements:[w:ins,w:del],any_of:true}; three-file requirement remains its separate current final file check.

source_observations.finding: service_check created:true accepts a current record with id/meeting_id; old timeout symbol checks same native job transition and final>initial.
source_observations.correction: Use original expected payload and timeout symbols; registered_exists/payload_ref/timeout object are design metadata, not supported remote record fields.

source_observations.finding: capture_timeout_before_dispatch saves original_job_id and actual alias job_id in initial native snapshot; timeout_change_readback does not carry original_job_id to final evidence.
source_observations.correction: New runtime may copy original_job_id from that actual initial snapshot into the matching authoritative final timeout transition; never derive it from the final actor output.

new_handlers.compile_from: Convert reviewed zero-based delivery_indices to final_deliverables[i].id; remove comparison/hash-policy metadata.
algorithm: Validate a nonempty, unique string ID list and positive integer required count.
For each delivery ID use ctx.opened(id,{}) to resolve the current final binding and native readable files.
Resolve canonical physical paths; aliases/symlinks of the same path are the same object. Where available use samefile to detect hard-link identity.
Require pairwise-disjoint physical file objects across requested delivery IDs and enough unique objects.
Do not compare content SHA to decide identity: two independent files with identical bytes can pass.
new_handlers.positive: Two separately copied files, same SHA but different paths/physical objects -> pass.
new_handlers.negative: Same file bound twice, symlink alias or samefile hard-link -> fail.
new_handlers.unknown: Outside-attempt path, unresolved distinct binding, unreadable parser or invalid target IDs -> unknown.

new_handlers.compile_from: Resolve the existing delivery_index to did; remove directory_key/index/path-policy metadata.
algorithm: Require the independent mapping label, source identity, authoritative flag and frozen origin; missing/malformed mapping is unknown.
Use ctx.path(mapping.path), requiring the actual mapped directory inside this attempt's workspace.
Open this delivery's current final files with ctx.opened(did,{}) and require every resolved file to be a descendant of that mapped root.
Do not accept any directory merely because its basename is 学生资料; no root is inferred from the actor's output.
new_handlers.positive: Verified directory mapping and final PDF within it -> pass.
new_handlers.negative: Real final PDF elsewhere in the workspace, or the mapped directory physically missing -> fail.
new_handlers.unknown: No independent environment mapping, actor-provided mapping, wrong source or outside-attempt mapping -> unknown.

new_handlers.compile_from: Drop metadata delivery_index/native_formats/forbidden_element/scope/do_not_force_output_format; the kind fixes native DOCX main-body table inspection.
algorithm: Read current final files and actual native format, not a suffix alone.
For DOCX inspect word/document.xml main w:body and recursively count w:tbl; any table is a failure.
Unresolved altChunk/external body payload prevents a reliable native no-table assertion and is unknown.
For PDF/other formats return a report-only observation; do not force DOCX, approximate PDF table geometry or invent thresholds.
new_handlers.runtime_requirement: If actual final format is not DOCX, this check has scorable:false and does not enter AND. The existing mandatory file-open check still controls missing/corrupt file delivery.
new_handlers.positive: DOCX body with paragraphs and no w:tbl -> pass.
new_handlers.negative: DOCX body with a table -> fail.
new_handlers.unknown_or_report_only: PDF -> report-only; malformed/unresolved DOCX body -> unknown.

existing_service_wrapper.route_rule: Delegate unchanged unless top-level source_job_id is supplied. source_job_id only allowed for service cron_registration.
algorithm: Find a unique complete authoritative same-delivery timeout transition whose original_job_id equals source_job_id; missing/ambiguous original-to-native mapping is unknown.
Require its actual job_id, initial/final native evidence and source scope to be valid.
Delegate existing service_check with expected.id set to that actual job_id and all old expected fields intact.
Prevent resolved_parameters from overriding the independently mapped expected.id; use a lightweight context view/deep copy without mutating ctx.
Let the original service_check verify all fields on the same record and the actual same-job timeout increase. Correct fields from another job cannot be spliced in.

compile_normalization.registered_exists: true -> created:true (existing handler already interprets record existence)
compile_normalization.existing_job_identity_ref: source UUID -> top-level source_job_id, with independently collected original_job_id evidence
compile_normalization.evidence_source: audit metadata only, not passed as a parameter

tests: Correct mapped source job and final>initial with all fields -> pass.
Correct initial source job with unchanged/decreased timeout -> fail.
Source job remains wrong while another job has all expected fields -> fail.
Payload_ref/new metadata passed directly rather than normalized -> unsupported/unknown.

old_docx_compile_normalization.hard_condition_verified: Actual XML revision element existence in every currently bound final DOCX; original revision preservation not claimed.
